_about: Grid for emulator_optimize.py: every key under 'parameters' is one VDF line '<array> <item> <value>',
the list holds the values to try. mode 'grid' = all combinations (here 5 x 3 = 15 variants + base),
mode 'one_at_a_time' = each value alone with the other parameters at the base VDF (5 + 3 + base).
Override on the command line:  --param "profile autoISF_max" 1.3 1.5  --mode one_at_a_time
